post.description:
Validate an intervention definition.

Checks:
- Intervention type is supported (registered in registry)
- Value constraints are valid
- Baseline and simulated values are feasible
- Target variable exists in the feature pipeline

Returns:
- is_valid: whether the intervention passes validation
- warnings: any validation warnings
- supported: whether the intervention type is supported
- constraints: effective constraints after validation

schema.title: Response Validate Intervention Api V1 Intervention Validate Post

post.description:
Create and run a counterfactual scenario.

Process:
1. Load baseline prediction from DB
2. Validate interventions
3. Apply interventions to feature values
4. Recompute derived features
5. Run same model for counterfactual prediction
6. Compare baseline vs counterfactual
7. Propagate uncertainty and OOD status
8. Generate equity analysis (if requested)

Returns:
- Baseline prediction details
- Counterfactual prediction details
- Risk delta and comparison
- Feature changes
- Limitations and disclaimers

Intervention.title: Intervention
Intervention.description:
A defined intervention for counterfactual simulation.

All intervention types must be validated against the KESHAV
feature pipeline. No causal claims are made about intervention
outcomes.

Supported intervention_type string values:
- outdoor_exposure_reduction
- work_rest_schedule
- shade_increase
- water_access_increase
- cooling_access_increase
- power_restoration
- exposure_time_shift
- combined

InterventionType.title: InterventionType
InterventionType.description:

Provides type-safe references to intervention type strings.
All values match the intervention_type field in the Intervention schema.
